integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 1312.2577 gives first submission 2013-12-09.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: A generic one-parameter subgroup of the row-column torus fixes exactly the coordinate Grassmannian points.
integrity.localization_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic \(\mathbb C^*\)-actions, and projectivity identifies it with ordinary Euler characteristic.
integrity.matching_basis: The primary paper proves that a coordinate point lies in either Fano scheme exactly when its bipartite graph has no matching of size \(r\).
integrity.object_basis: The primary paper defines the determinantal and permanental Fano schemes inside the same Grassmannian.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The published paper lists primary MSC 14M12.

scientific_limitations: The theorem computes only ordinary Euler characteristic; it does not assert equality of Betti numbers, motives, components, reduced structures, or singularities.
For general \(r\), the answer is expressed by the natural finite matching-avoidance number \(B_{m,n,r}(k+1)\); no universal closed form for that graph count is claimed.
The localization argument is short after the shared fixed-point criterion is known, so an equivalent unindexed or folklore observation remains possible.
title: Determinant and permanent Fano schemes have the same Euler characteristic
